## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. The subtitle names the object by its label

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T09:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** every bell Activity row shows a raw API name beside a summary that already uses the label. It is cosmetic.
- **Direction:** `InboxPopover`'s activity subtitle resolves the object's label in the reader's locale, the way the row's summary does. It falls back to the API name only when no label resolves.
  - ⛔ No label copied into `sys_activity`: the row keeps `object_name`, and the console resolves it.
- Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/layout` (`domain:ui`); rationale: one component.

Claim: PM loop round 8 (as triage `6121938464` directs: `InboxPopover`'s activity subtitle resolves the object's label in the reader's locale, the way the row's summary does, and falls back to the API name only when no label resolves; ⛔ no label copied into `sys_activity`)
Session: `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`
Account: `os-steve`
Branch: `claude/issue-12212-activity-object-label`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12212`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface, on objectui `main` `a491b64`:
- **The row:** `packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx`, the activity row's second line near line 701, `{timeAgo(...)} · {a.objectName}`.
- **The mapping:** `packages/app-shell/src/layout/activityItemType.ts` (`objectName: String(r.object_name ?? '')`, near line 266). Read; changed only if the label lookup belongs at the mapping and not the render.
- **The label:** the console's existing object-label path (`useObjectLabel` in `@object-ui/i18n`, over the object definitions the console already holds). Read, ⛔ not changed.
- Co-located tests, and `.changeset/12212-activity-object-label.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`).
- ⛔ No new i18n key, no published export, prop or type change, and nothing on the server: `sys_activity` keeps `object_name`.
- ⛔ The layout files another seat's objectui#12201 is changing (`AppHeader.tsx`, `AppSwitcher.tsx`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`) are not touched.
- (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `S/M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui's bell Activity tab (@object-ui/app-shell InboxPopover), which renders each row's object by its raw API name beside a summary that already uses the label | the console resolves object labels in the reader's locale everywhere else (useObjectLabel), and sys_activity carries object_name for the console to resolve | every user opening the bell's Activity tab: measured on the 2026-10-12 cloud staging walk (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 5), where each row reads "… · sys_user_preference" and a lead row "… · crm_lead"`
Thread-read: 6121938464
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-12T10:51Z on objectui `main` `a491b64`:
- **Duplicates:** no remote branch or open PR touches this card's subject.
- **Another seat's objectui#12201** (branch `claude/issue-12201-app-identity-top-bar`, no PR yet) changes `AppHeader.tsx`, `AppSwitcher.tsx`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` and two new layout modules. It does not touch `InboxPopover.tsx` or `activityItemType.ts`.
- **This seat's in-flight work:** objectui#12220 (`app-shell` `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `plugin-detail`), objectui#12217 (`plugin-list`), and PRs objectui#12230 (`core`, the entitlement dialog) and objectui#12226 (`app-shell` entry, `PageView`, `console` vite config). None touches these files.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#12237 (head `9662600326`) · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK` · 2026-10-12T11:18Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report (`os-dev-report` `6123182436`). Claim `6122805649`.

### Verdict

- **Shape:**
  - Draft on `main`. The first line is `Fixes #12212`, and `Clause-②: no` sits at a line start.
  - Assignee `os-steve`. The commit trailers and the body carry no model identifier.
- **Scope:** 3 files, +219/−2. `check-governed-merges`: NOT governed.
- **The fix follows triage: the console resolves the label, and `sys_activity` keeps `object_name`.**
  - A module-private `ActivityObjectLabel` in `InboxPopover.tsx` reads the definition's `label` from `useMetadata().objects` in the active language, through the same `findByName` / `metadataText` pair `useNavTargetLabel` uses.
  - It passes that through `useObjectLabel().objectLabel`, so a bundle `objects.<name>.label` wins.
  - It falls back to the API name only when that answer is empty.
  - `activityItemType.ts` is unchanged.
- **No N reads for N rows.** `objects` is the shell's cached list, one read for the whole type.
  - The label is its own component, so a closed bell never reads that list. That is pinned: 0 reads while closed, more than 0 on the Activity tab.
  - Removing the component boundary turns the pin red.
- **System objects resolve.** The dev read objectstack `main` `794177d9b`'s object-list gate: it prunes `listViews` and masks fields but drops no object. So `sys_user_preference` is in the cached list with its label.
  - That is a source reading, not a live `/meta/object` call, and the PR body says so.
- **The pins carry weight:**
  - en `Lead`, en `User Preference`, and zh-CN 「线索」 from the bundle;
  - an unknown `crm_gone` falls back to its name;
  - the summaries are verbatim in both languages.
  - Putting the row back on `a.objectName` turns 4 red, and the restore is blob-equal.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`. No export, prop, type member or language-pack key.
- **Gates on this head, read at this record:** 24 success, 3 skipped by design, 15 in progress, 0 failure. The seat enqueues only once all of them read `success`.

### Out-of-scope finding

- **Home's activity card has the same defect.** `HomeActivity` (`packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeRail.tsx`) renders `timeAgo(…) · a.objectName` from the same shared activity feed.
  - The dev's throwaway render probe read `3 hours ago · crm_lead` with a `Lead` definition in the metadata context. The probe was not committed.
  - `reach:` named producer: plugin-audit's `sys_activity.object_name`, through `sharedUserFeeds.ts`, which is the same read that feeds the bell.
  - It is outside this claim's file surface, and this card's acceptance (the bell) passes without it, so it is not folded in.
  - The seat files it as its own card, citing this ruling and mechanism.

**Landing:** ready and auto-merge through the merge queue once every check on `9662600` is `success` or skipped by design. `behind` is not a veto.
